name: Jayantika/ଜୟନ୍ତିକା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jayantika is the literary name of Jayanti Panda, an Odia poet who taught political science. In a personal recollection, fellow writer Pradeep Biswal traces her teaching career from Vyasanagar College to government colleges and her retirement as a reader at JKBK College in Cuttack. Her Kabita Live biography records her continued dedication to creative writing after retirement.

“ନିରକ୍ଷରା” questions what it means to be unable to read. Its eyes understand joy, loss and tenderness beyond the reach of grammar, while an impatient world mistrusts such sensitivity. The closing uncertainty over whose heartbeat is being heard makes intimacy itself a form of understanding.
